person_made_it: Gordon's team, art and voice: the boss-ball mascot, his roster names, a David-voice announcer and teammate calls all made for this game, not stock.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The arena announcer (David, ElevenLabs) calls the match; teammates shout 'Three!' and 'Ball left'; COACH FIORE's bench card shows plans as game labels, never quotes.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Night in a lit Vegas-style rec gym: spotlights, a loud home crowd, Boss Black around a bright maple court.
did_the_click_pay_me: One click on PC starts the announcer and music and the next tap is a match; the first catch brings a teammate back with a crowd roar.
works_for_the_recipient: Opens full window at native resolution with keyboard and mouse, key legend on screen, Auto quality that trims render scale before detail; tested in WebKit (macOS engine, not iOS Safari) and Chromium.
taught_me_something: The rules teach themselves in play: the 15 s control clock counts 3, 2, 1 out loud and the first ball you hold prompts DASH, THEN THROW with the U key.
told_me_the_truth: Real Sin City rules (15 s control per the rulebook); FINAL BOSS players get strength-forward ratings from receipts only; the save-on-deflection rule is flagged for Gordon to confirm.
weakest: No gamepad support yet (planned P8), so couch players with a controller cannot play.
